text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The National Council of State, which groups military administrators of all 36 states and other top brass met at the presidency in Abuja on Friday over recent bomb blasts in Lagos.
- Family of former government chief secretary and one time presidential aspirant Olu Falae says he was wrongly detained over Lagos bombings, say he is innocent.
- Former senator Abraham Adesanya, a leading member of the opposition NADECO group alleges that there are plans to kill him as well as NADECO's 88-year-old leader Michael Ajasin.
- Oil minister Dan Etete alays fears that there will be increase in pump prices of petrol in the 1997 fiscal budget soon to be released by the federal government.
- United States embassy in Lagos condemns bomb blasts in Lagos and its perpetrators.
